verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships built-in AI features for two narrow tasks: generating a mock server from a natural-language prompt, OpenAPI definition, or URL (with routes and responses scaffolded automatically), and suggesting commit messages. It shows no general-purpose assistant that can take on arbitrary tasks across the product. The MCP client lets Insomnia connect to external MCP servers, which is a related but different capability, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general conversational or agentic assistant that accepts arbitrary tasks, AI help with requests, tests, scripts or spec design, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
